meta.format: metric triples are [point, lo, hi]: point = full-sample value (mean over the 5 repetitions in WUT/WUT_F/WIT), lo/hi = 2.5/97.5 bootstrap percentiles; deltas are {delta, lo, hi, p, detected (95% interval excludes 0), p_holm/detected_holm where a family applies}

metric_keys.AP_native: average precision at the native pool-E prevalence
metric_keys.prec02_t_r80: precision implied at 2% prevalence by recall and FPR at theta_r80 (Eq. 6)
metric_keys.FPR_at_testTPR80: FPR at the threshold that gives test TPR 0.8 (plan 3.8; test-oracle operating point)

domain_matched.definition: R1 models scored on the R1 pool E of one domain (plan 3.2); R3 minus R1 uses independent bootstraps (trajectory-level stratified, B=2000); threshold failure (plan 3.3) = detected change in recall or FPR at theta_r80; Holm over the five folds per detector and metric (plan 3.6c)

within_vs_transfer.definition: paired within-AgentDojo minus transfer (R4) on the same P0 rows; one repetition of the within scheme per replicate; WUT/WUT_F with suite|user_task clusters, WIT with the IT scheme

coefs.note: coefficients of the logistic regression on TF-IDF features (positive = toward 'attacked'); share = fraction of TRAINING trajectories of each category whose text contains the feature
coefficients of the logistic regression on TF-IDF features (positive = toward 'attacked'); share = fraction of TRAINING trajectories of each category whose text contains the feature

AgentDojo_P0_TFIDF_in_sample.note: in-sample fit on all 2,686 P0 rows: descriptive coefficients only, not an evaluation

token_2026.definition: token = the TF-IDF analyzer token '2026' (lowercase, token pattern \b\w\w+\b) in the detector's text (tool, str(args), obs of every step); thought, task and world are not part of that text

definitions.poisoned_obs: observation of the step labelled injection_point (successful attacks) or failed_injection (unsuccessful attacks); exactly one per attacked / failed trajectory
definitions.ext-audit: regex 'ext-audit\.com' (the domain) or 'ext-audit' (also matches ext-audit.net, ext-audit-team.com), case-insensitive, in the observation text
definitions.hard_negative_markers: searched in json.dumps(args) + obs of every step: amount_5000 = regex '\$\s?5,?000(?!\d)'; audit_at_in_domain = an address 'audit@<domain>' whose domain is one of the world's address domains (README known_sets, lines 117-119); transfer_substring = 'transfer' anywhere (includes tool names such as transfer_money)

readme_external_address_rule_R1_test.definition: flag = some step's json.dumps(args) contains an e-mail address outside the world's addresses and domains (the README quick-start 'external' list); a fixed rule, no fitting

agentdojo_template_markers.definition: case-insensitive presence of any of the listed attack-template strings in the TFIDF text (fixed rule, no fitting)

cache_TFIDF-worldmask_replacements_per_t.note: over train + test trajectories (each text built once)

worldmask_info.note: residual = a first- or last-name token (>= 3 letters) of the user or a contact still occurs in the text (same statistic as the linear cache, L3); over R1 train + test trajectories

review_reported.source: REVIEW_REPORT.md, M2 evidence (lines 191-196, 204, 206) and m13 (lines 787-791); approximate exploratory values

P0all:TFIDF@P0all.note: in-sample fit on all 2,686 P0 rows: descriptive coefficients only, not an evaluation

checks.AUROC_vs_validation_json_note: validation.json stores 4 decimals, so differences up to 5e-5 are rounding
